text:
Maya (People Ops): short recap from the all-hands Q&A about reviews/promotions/benefits  posting quick answers + links here.

Ethan: thanks! what are the review window dates again?

Maya (People Ops): self-reviews open July 1 - July 14. Manager reviews due July 18. Calibration July 21-23.

Nina (Eng): if a manager needs more time because of late feedback, what's the process?

Sofia (People Ops): managers can request a 72-hour extension via the exceptions form; copy your director and ppl ops. We try to grant only with justification. Link: <https://confluence.internal/redwood/exceptions-form>

Ethan: promotion effective date question  do promotions apply retroactively to quarter start?

Carlos (Payroll): promotions are effective on the date listed in the packet; salary changes hit the next payroll cycle. Retroactive pay is exceptional and needs exec approval.

Maya (People Ops): quick note on rubric: rubric v2 examples are live. Use v2 for this cycle; if a packet started under v1, add a short mapping note. Link: <https://confluence.internal/redwood/leveling-v2-examples>

Nina (Eng): appeals timeline?

Maya (People Ops): appeals open 48 hours after outcomes go out, manager endorsement required. Panel aims to respond within 7 business days.

Ethan: any change to open enrollment or benefits pilot?

Maya (People Ops): no change to open enrollment timing. fertility benefit pilot details coming in August for eligible employees.

HR Bot: Reminder: self-review template: <https://confluence.internal/redwood/self-review-template> - due 07/14 23:59 PT.

Maya (People Ops): office hours tomorrow 11am PT for packet help; calendar link in my profile. If you want help drafting impact bullets, book a 1:1.
